claims.what: ARC 1 had three layers (model safety validation, cognitive certification, operational authorization) and did not address compliance after deployment
the certified baseline is defined as a region rather than a fixed point and deviation is measured by continuous monitoring
isolated outliers are quarantined pending confirmation before they enter the evaluation
a layered trigger taxonomy: hard safety violations, critical single-dimension failures, correlated multi-system degradation, risk-weighted composites
a graduated safe-transition protocol separates withdrawal of operational authorization from physical shutdown
drift beyond the certified operational design domain triggers recertification or ODD revision rather than automatic authority contraction
the framework addresses continuous-compliance obligations in EU AI Act Article 72(2)
